Note: Same position as A0.2 J100; keyed ribbon to P4 JP1.
C6_3V3 is the C6 supply: sense only, do not feed.
The shutter button lead plugs in here: a dry contact to GND. GPIO28 has the internal pull-up and the 25 ms debounce in buttons.c; no resistor. Keyed, so it cannot go in reversed.
Protects the board and the source if the rail shorts; the TPS2553s only protect the nodes.
Two contacts per rail. 1-2 VBUS out through U1002 to the SW6106 input (the battery charges from the carrier USB-C), 3-4 GND, 5-6 the 5 V rail back from the SW6106 output. 20 AWG to the module.
Same centres as A0.2: 22 mm pitch. Pin 2 D1 sync, 7 D6 TX, 8 D7 RX.
